title: Yoisaki Kanade — Seeing Her In A Child〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to leave for school...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Do you know when you'll be back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should be able to come back early since we don't have club activities today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seems much better now compared to when she first started staying over...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you going to keep working, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you should at least take a quick nap. You stayed up all night working, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, you usually fall asleep at your desk. You should be sleeping in your bed instead.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I should get my act together if I don't want Mafuyu to worry so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe something simpler would be better.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That didn't work... Then, how about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You weren't also working just now, were you, Amia...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, I was watching an anime marathon!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry... I know there isn't much for you to do until I'm finished working on this demo...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't worry about me! Also, there's no rush! I mean, a lot did happen recently.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Take your time and make it a good one♪ In the meantime, I'll try to hone my craft by watching some good works.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, K, Amia, you're both already here. Were you both working just now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm still a little lost, but I'm slowly making progress.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I mean, is she gonna be okay?
She still seemed pretty down about what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I'm also a little worried...
But I want to respect her decision to go. She said there are no club activities today, so she should be back early.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Yeah, I guess she should go if she thinks she can.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But if anything does happen, let me know! I'll be right over to help!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thank you...
If the situation arises, then I'll be calling on you both.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm going to mute myself and get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now, if I can just finalize this part...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, someone's at the door...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I almost fell over in my own room...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hmm... I really need to clean up soon...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: B-Be right there! Just give me one second...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
M-Mafuyu... I'm so sorry...!
I didn't hear the doorbell ring...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay.
This is your house after all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that's no excuse for me to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm trying to provide her with a place of refuge, but if I keep doing these things...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... I feel really guilty about what just happened. I should try to find a way to prevent this from happening again.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You don't have to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know. What if I gave you my key?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, you wouldn't be able to go anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That shouldn't be a problem since I hardly ever leave the house. Wait, visiting the hospital won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm okay with things just the way they are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you should be able to treat this house as your own while you're staying here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
Maybe I should have a spare key made for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That way, we'd both be able to come and go as we please.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I am. I'll go have one made.
